RES-0179.reviewer_requirement: two reviewers with disjoint mandates: a legal/licence reviewer and a security reviewer; both must PASS (spec:11045-11060)
tests_required: detector control: fetch a known-reachable control URL through the same path and require success, so a blocked verdict cannot be a broken fetcher

RES-0180.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial refuter in a fresh context who defaults to REFUTED when evidence is insufficient (spec:11062)
tests_required: both-states control: a source that genuinely changed must wake the watcher, and a source that only changed its ad markup or timestamp must NOT - a watcher that wakes on both is a poller

RES-0182.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial refuter in a fresh context who defaults to REFUTED when evidence is insufficient (spec:11062)
tests_required: negative control: include 2 questions that DO have a literature answer, elicit blind, and compare - if elicitation misses a known answer the mode is reported as weak rather than adopted
